title: Brückner Group - LinkedIn
content:
Overview:
The Brückner Group is the market leader in the engineering of machines and systems for plastics and alternative materials. We are a family-owned company whose global success is built on technological market leadership. Our strong business units – Brückner Maschinenbau, Brückner Servtec, Hennecke, Kiefel and PackSys Global – are synonymous with specialized solutions and unique synergies in the fields of plastics & alternatives, packaging & technical applications, machines & production plants as well as solution providing. Marrying global presence and local commitment, we offer our customers excellent service, innovative technologies, and sustainable partnerships. Whether in Siegsdorf, Freilassing, Sankt Augustin, Rüti, Topolcany, Navi Mumbai, Dover, Bogota, Chon Buri, or Suzhou – the Brückner Group is at home around the world and is shaping the future of the plastics and packaging industry. We are the Brückner Group. 3,350 employees 21 locations 12 countries 1 group

title: Brueckner Group USA
content: Five Strong Business Units Form the Basis of Our Actions. ## Your Center for Service and Engineering Excellence. Brueckner Group USA, based in Dover, New Hampshire, is your trusted partner for sales, service, and production support across the United States, Canada, and Mexico. At the heart of our operations is the Customer Innovation Center, where we bring new ideas and technologies to life. As the independent distribution partner for all Brückner Group business units, we deliver custom solutions and top-tier service across North America – from testing and innovation to repair and maintenance – ensuring your operations stay efficient, reliable, and future-ready. We develop pioneering systems and technologies for the processing of polyurethane in the form of tailored and standardized customer solutions. In 2026, we will introduce a new leading company within the Brückner Group: Hennecke PUR Solutions will expand the Group’s portfolio with key technologies for processing polyurethane (PUR).
